newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BARCELONA TO FACE REAL MADRID IN SPANISH CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA TO FACE REAL MADRID IN SPANISH CUP.

text.p: MADRID, Jan 23 (Reuter) Spanish giants Real Madrid and
Barcelona will face each other in the fourth round of the
Spanish Cup after being paired together in Thursday's draw.
Barcelona will have home advantage for the first leg of the
tie, scheduled for January 29 and February 5. The sides would
not normally meet so early in the Cup but Real have not been
seeded after failing to qualify for Europe last season.
Among other sides involved in European competition, holders
Atletico play struggling first division side Compostela, while
Valencia have the easiest task of the big teams, against second
division Las Palmas.
But another UEFA Cup side, Tenerife, will start as underdogs
against high-flying Real Betis.
23-times winners Athletic Bilbao will have to make the short
trip to another mid-table side, Racing Santander.
Full fourth round draw. First-named teams play first leg at
home. Legs scheduled for Wednesday, January 29 and Wednesday,
February 5:
Barcelona v Real Madrid
Atletico Madrid v Compostela
Deportivo Coruna v Espanyol
Tenerife v Real Betis
Rayo Vallecano v Extremadura
Racing Santander v Athletic Bilbao
Las Palmas v Valencia
Lleida v Celta Vigo
